defects.title: API health hard-coded READY
defects.root_cause: The compatibility API endpoint returned a literal READY state instead of delegating to a shared health authority.
defects.historical_reproducer: Construct a runtime with a missing artifact directory and query health.
defects.closure_criteria: Direct health and API/status paths cannot report READY when a mandatory local prerequisite fails.

defects.title: No profile second-instance/stale-lock lifecycle authority
defects.root_cause: Independent entry points had no shared runtime lease/discovery lifecycle.
defects.historical_reproducer: Acquire the same profile twice or leave a dead-pid lock behind.
defects.closure_criteria: Second instance is refused, stale dead-process locks reconcile, and clean shutdown removes discovery/lock files.

defects.title: Arbitrage deterministic suite not collected by canonical verifier
defects.root_cause: The plugin tests import tests/helpers.py as a top-level helpers module, but the canonical verifier initially exposed only plugin src on PYTHONPATH.
defects.authority: central verification environment for plugin-owned suite
defects.historical_reproducer: Run the arbitrage pytest suite with only src on PYTHONPATH.
defects.closure_criteria: Canonical full verification collects and executes the complete plugin suite without modifying plugin-owned source/test files in a CORE workstream.

defects.title: Duplicate Prediction Markets implementations
defects.root_cause: Two delivered package shapes expose the same stable plugin ID with different manifest/contract semantics.
defects.historical_reproducer: Discover plugin manifests across plugins/ and root src/ trees.
defects.closure_criteria: Primary Development selects one canonical implementation and the non-canonical duplicate is migrated/retired without losing validated behavior.

defects.title: Repository/package root split
defects.root_cause: Core packaging was nested under alpha_engine/ while later cylinder deliveries landed at repository-root plugin/src/test trees.
defects.historical_reproducer: Attempt one editable install/test command from repository root before the root pyproject exists.
defects.closure_criteria: Root install is authoritative and all accepted canonical cylinders are re-homed/activated through one frozen PDK with obsolete root-src duplicates dispositioned.

defects.title: Feature verification omitted declared prerequisites
defects.root_cause: Feature mode selected only checks directly mapped to the feature and did not close over each check's prerequisite graph.
defects.historical_reproducer: Run `alpha verify feature AE-RUN-003`; V13-LIFECYCLE was previously blocked because V01-IMPORT-SANITY was not scheduled.
defects.closure_criteria: Every selected feature check executes after all declared transitive prerequisites, without scheduling unrelated checks.

defects.title: Runtime discovery published READY before loopback socket was serving
defects.root_cause: The headless serve path wrote READY immediately before entering blocking uvicorn.run(), creating a race where status clients could observe READY and receive connection refused.
defects.historical_reproducer: Start a headless runtime and query status immediately after runtime.json first reports READY.
defects.closure_criteria: READY discovery is published only after the loopback server confirms it has started, and immediate status succeeds.
